title: Microtrend mapping and verticalized competitor signals for model-fit prioritization
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: produce a lightweight, repeatable microtrend map that links emergent model capabilities (latency/cost tradeoffs, structured output primitives, instruction-following fidelity) to high-value enterprise verticals and concrete product signals. Deliver a prioritized list of model-fit hypotheses and an automated ingestion recipe for continuous signals (benchmarks, PRs, adoption telemetry, partner interviews).

Scope: scope covers 6 weeks of reconnaissance + 2-week prototype for the ingestion pipeline. Focus verticals for the first pass: fintech (risk scoring, document understanding), healthcare (PII detection, summarization), and developer platform (chat/code assist).

Outcomes: (1) microtrend taxonomy and scoring rubric, (2) verticalized competitor signals dashboard prototype (CSV + Looker draft), (3) 10 prioritized model-fit hypotheses with recommended product friction/advantage levers, (4) ingestion recipe (sources, frequency, normalization rules) and a minimal automation script for weekly refresh.

Why now: model release cadence and open-source innovation accelerated; sales cycles are increasingly model-aware. We need a high-signal, operational view to inform Dedicated capacity roadmap, onboarding prioritization, and sales enablement pitches.
acceptance_criteria: Microtrend taxonomy documented and reviewed by PM+Research (owner sign-off)
Scoring rubric with at least 5 signals and weighting rationale published
Prototype dashboard populated with ≥3 weeks of historical signals for target verticals
Ingestion recipe with synthetic-run example and a GitHub action that updates CSV on schedule
10 model-fit hypotheses with owner, estimated revenue/defense impact, and implementation complexity
